sections.heading: Plot
sections.wikitext:
'''An Old Enemy'''

In [[:Category:Velo, Greece|Velos, Greece]], a couple of [[The Organization|Organization]] [[Suits]] are attacked by [[Silent Soldiers]] as they attempt to bring back supplies to [[Sutos Island]]. The Suits fight back but focus on stopping them from invoking [[Titans]] as to not alert civilians. They're initially overpowered but then saved by [[Dante Vale|Dante]], [[Den Fears|Den]], [[Lok Lambert|Lok]], and [[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]], who end up making the Soldiers flee. Dante tells the Suits that he is not interested in fighting them, and asks them for help.

The two Suits guide the [[Huntik Foundation|Huntik]] team to Sutos on a boat as Lok and Sophie explain Den the history behind Sutos, and how they're here to talk to a respected Organization Seeker to help fight the [[Blood Spiral]]. 

After arriving at the island, the injured Suits meet with [[Grier]] and the [[Governor of Sutos]] at the palace. They're both thankful they made it out in one piece, unlike other Organization groups attacked by the Spirals. Dante and his team also enter the palace to talk with Grier about the Blood Spiral, and although he doesn't have anything against them, says that Sutos is not the place for Huntik Foundation [[Seekers]] to be at and that he already has enough problems related to his mean being attacked. The team convince Grier by stating that his old colleague, [[Rassimov]], is the one leading the Blood Spiral.
[[File:S2E46 Lok Sophie Dante Grier.png|thumb|[[Grier]] has an idea on how to take out the [[Blood Spiral|Spirals]]]]
On the shore, the team explain that Rassimov betrayed the Organization and is now planning to destroy civilization alongside the other Spirals. Grier realizes the importance of the situation, but doesn't want to leave his people behind. However, he does come up with something to help the Foundation defeat Rassimov. He realizes that [[Simon Judeau|the Professor]] was probably suspicious of Rassimov, and must have been keeping data on his weaknesses. From this is born "[[The Professor's Dossier]]" mission.

'''Raiding the Castle'''

The team is joined by Grier at [[the Professor's castle]]. There, they encounter several Suits and Dante insists he and Grier should take them out by themselves for the others to save power. They fight in perfect synchrony and without any [[Titans]] take out the Suits with ease. In the meanwhile, Den is annoyed that he can't fight, but Sophie and Lok explain that Dante and Grier used to be rivals, and a moment like this is important for them. This makes Den remember the relationship between him and his brother, [[Harrison Fears|Harrison]], and [[Cherit]] tells him one day they'll be on the same side.
[[File:S2E46 Dante Touchram Doberman Megataur Undergolem.png|thumb|[[Megataur]] and [[Undergolem]] clash as [[Dante Vale|Dante]] tries to take out [[Doberman]]]]
[[Wilder]] then appears on an elevated part of the castle and tells the team that he's planning on using Rassimov's files to blackmail him into being the Spirals' leader. He's joined by [[Hoffman]] and [[Eathon the dog]], and the latter invokes two [[Undergolem]] Titans as an emotional response to the castle being threatened, while Hoffman invokes [[Doberman]]. Dante tells Lok to complete the mission alongside Den and Cherit, and Sophie states that she will handle Wilder. Lok invokes [[Baselaird|Powerbonded Baselaird]] to help Dante and Grier with the Organization's Titans, the latter also invoking [[Megataur]].

The Titans begin fighting and eventually one Undergolem Titan is taken out, and Hoffman sends [[Alpha]] and [[Beta]] to attempt to defeat Grier and Dante. In the meanwhile, Sophie faces Wilder and asks him once again to help the Foundation in taking out the Spirals, but this time as leader of the [[Casterwill family|Casterwill]] elders. Sophie states that she thought Wilder was different from the likes of [[DeFoe]] or [[Klaus]], but as Wilder attacks Sophie while describing his ambitions, she calls him and a coward. Wilder begins to think Sophie is just distracting him while the others get the files, and invoking [[Incubane]] to fight Sophie and runs away to look for the files.  

'''The Professor's Room'''  

Elsewhere in the castle, Lok and Den are stopped by [[Unnamed Suit 057]] and [[Unnamed Suit 058]], as well as the former's [[Doom Warden]] Titan. The two Foundation Seekers make quick work of the enemies and head to [[Simon Judeau|Simon]]'s room as Sophie invokes [[Phoenix]] to deal with Incubane. Now in the Professor's study, Cherit notices how Den looks up to Lok; this gives Lok the idea of going to his [[Lambert house|childhood house]] in [[Ireland]] alongside Den in a vacation. While searching the room, Lok finds an old picture of Simon, [[Metz]] and [[Eathon]], with a date on the back.  
[[File:S2E46 Widler Grier 3.png|thumb|[[Grier]] disciplines [[Wilder]]]]
At the entrance, the previously summoned Titans continue fighting and Dante approaches Hoffman, also trying to convince him to fight the Spirals. But he's too stubborn and a fight ensues. Grier goes up the castle and heads to the Professor's room to help Lok, who finds out a hidden safe whose password is the date on the old photograph. They find the files, but Wilder attacks Lok from behind, severely injuring him. Wilder invokes [[Grand Façade]] and Den struggles to fight them. With Cherit's help, Den temporarily prevents him from getting the files, but gets overpowered. As he's about to be taken out by Wilder, Grier enters the room and fights the Organization leader, but gets grabbed by Grand Façade. As the Titan is about to take out Grier, he powerbonds with [[Breaker]], who is able to send Grand Façade back to its amulet while Grier swiftly defeats Wilder, telling him that they're going back to Sutos, where Wilder will learn the meaning of "Organization control".  

'''The Organization's Downfall'''  

The team's Titans manage to overpower the remaining Organization Titans, and Dante restrains Hoffman with [[Stopglue]] and [[Bristlebind]]. The others return with the files, and Grier tells Hoffman to protect the castle, but to never leave its walls. Later, Dante asks Grier to join the Foundation, but he says his people need him, and it's better for him to stay on the island given he's not proud of some things he has done while in the Organization. On the helicopter, Den again wonders if him and his brother will ever be on the same side again.  In the [[Blood Spiral Base]], Rassimov announces he will deal with the Huntik Foundation with a power given to him by [[the Betrayer]] himself.

Sophie faces her fears again to challenge Shauna and Wind to a deadly battle in the volcano. Lok, Dante, Cherit, and Den fight with all they have, but it looks like they're in trouble. Finally, Sophie leaps into the lava. She rises from the ashes, having bonded with the Legendary Titan of Rebirth, Phoenix.

plot_sections.wikitext:
'''An Old Enemy'''

In [[:Category:Velo, Greece|Velos, Greece]], a couple of [[The Organization|Organization]] [[Suits]] are attacked by [[Silent Soldiers]] as they attempt to bring back supplies to [[Sutos Island]]. The Suits fight back but focus on stopping them from invoking [[Titans]] as to not alert civilians. They're initially overpowered but then saved by [[Dante Vale|Dante]], [[Den Fears|Den]], [[Lok Lambert|Lok]], and [[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]], who end up making the Soldiers flee. Dante tells the Suits that he is not interested in fighting them, and asks them for help.

The two Suits guide the [[Huntik Foundation|Huntik]] team to Sutos on a boat as Lok and Sophie explain Den the history behind Sutos, and how they're here to talk to a respected Organization Seeker to help fight the [[Blood Spiral]]. 

After arriving at the island, the injured Suits meet with [[Grier]] and the [[Governor of Sutos]] at the palace. They're both thankful they made it out in one piece, unlike other Organization groups attacked by the Spirals. Dante and his team also enter the palace to talk with Grier about the Blood Spiral, and although he doesn't have anything against them, says that Sutos is not the place for Huntik Foundation [[Seekers]] to be at and that he already has enough problems related to his mean being attacked. The team convince Grier by stating that his old colleague, [[Rassimov]], is the one leading the Blood Spiral.
[[File:S2E46 Lok Sophie Dante Grier.png|thumb|[[Grier]] has an idea on how to take out the [[Blood Spiral|Spirals]]]]
On the shore, the team explain that Rassimov betrayed the Organization and is now planning to destroy civilization alongside the other Spirals. Grier realizes the importance of the situation, but doesn't want to leave his people behind. However, he does come up with something to help the Foundation defeat Rassimov. He realizes that [[Simon Judeau|the Professor]] was probably suspicious of Rassimov, and must have been keeping data on his weaknesses. From this is born "[[The Professor's Dossier]]" mission.

'''Raiding the Castle'''

The team is joined by Grier at [[the Professor's castle]]. There, they encounter several Suits and Dante insists he and Grier should take them out by themselves for the others to save power. They fight in perfect synchrony and without any [[Titans]] take out the Suits with ease. In the meanwhile, Den is annoyed that he can't fight, but Sophie and Lok explain that Dante and Grier used to be rivals, and a moment like this is important for them. This makes Den remember the relationship between him and his brother, [[Harrison Fears|Harrison]], and [[Cherit]] tells him one day they'll be on the same side.
[[File:S2E46 Dante Touchram Doberman Megataur Undergolem.png|thumb|[[Megataur]] and [[Undergolem]] clash as [[Dante Vale|Dante]] tries to take out [[Doberman]]]]
[[Wilder]] then appears on an elevated part of the castle and tells the team that he's planning on using Rassimov's files to blackmail him into being the Spirals' leader. He's joined by [[Hoffman]] and [[Eathon the dog]], and the latter invokes two [[Undergolem]] Titans as an emotional response to the castle being threatened, while Hoffman invokes [[Doberman]]. Dante tells Lok to complete the mission alongside Den and Cherit, and Sophie states that she will handle Wilder. Lok invokes [[Baselaird|Powerbonded Baselaird]] to help Dante and Grier with the Organization's Titans, the latter also invoking [[Megataur]].

The Titans begin fighting and eventually one Undergolem Titan is taken out, and Hoffman sends [[Alpha]] and [[Beta]] to attempt to defeat Grier and Dante. In the meanwhile, Sophie faces Wilder and asks him once again to help the Foundation in taking out the Spirals, but this time as leader of the [[Casterwill family|Casterwill]] elders. Sophie states that she thought Wilder was different from the likes of [[DeFoe]] or [[Klaus]], but as Wilder attacks Sophie while describing his ambitions, she calls him and a coward. Wilder begins to think Sophie is just distracting him while the others get the files, and invoking [[Incubane]] to fight Sophie and runs away to look for the files.  

'''The Professor's Room'''  

Elsewhere in the castle, Lok and Den are stopped by [[Unnamed Suit 057]] and [[Unnamed Suit 058]], as well as the former's [[Doom Warden]] Titan. The two Foundation Seekers make quick work of the enemies and head to [[Simon Judeau|Simon]]'s room as Sophie invokes [[Phoenix]] to deal with Incubane. Now in the Professor's study, Cherit notices how Den looks up to Lok; this gives Lok the idea of going to his [[Lambert house|childhood house]] in [[Ireland]] alongside Den in a vacation. While searching the room, Lok finds an old picture of Simon, [[Metz]] and [[Eathon]], with a date on the back.  
[[File:S2E46 Widler Grier 3.png|thumb|[[Grier]] disciplines [[Wilder]]]]
At the entrance, the previously summoned Titans continue fighting and Dante approaches Hoffman, also trying to convince him to fight the Spirals. But he's too stubborn and a fight ensues. Grier goes up the castle and heads to the Professor's room to help Lok, who finds out a hidden safe whose password is the date on the old photograph. They find the files, but Wilder attacks Lok from behind, severely injuring him. Wilder invokes [[Grand Façade]] and Den struggles to fight them. With Cherit's help, Den temporarily prevents him from getting the files, but gets overpowered. As he's about to be taken out by Wilder, Grier enters the room and fights the Organization leader, but gets grabbed by Grand Façade. As the Titan is about to take out Grier, he powerbonds with [[Breaker]], who is able to send Grand Façade back to its amulet while Grier swiftly defeats Wilder, telling him that they're going back to Sutos, where Wilder will learn the meaning of "Organization control".  

'''The Organization's Downfall'''  

The team's Titans manage to overpower the remaining Organization Titans, and Dante restrains Hoffman with [[Stopglue]] and [[Bristlebind]]. The others return with the files, and Grier tells Hoffman to protect the castle, but to never leave its walls. Later, Dante asks Grier to join the Foundation, but he says his people need him, and it's better for him to stay on the island given he's not proud of some things he has done while in the Organization. On the helicopter, Den again wonders if him and his brother will ever be on the same side again.  In the [[Blood Spiral Base]], Rassimov announces he will deal with the Huntik Foundation with a power given to him by [[the Betrayer]] himself.
